# fw-drive crate

> A Google Drive style file service in Rust: folders, uploads into content-addressed blobs, trash, stars, search, inherited sharing, quota, a JSON API and HTML…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-drive/

A Google Drive style file service in Rust: folders, uploads into content-addressed blobs, trash, stars, search, inherited sharing, quota, a JSON API and HTML pages, over SQLite and files or over Cloudflare D1 and R2
